# Isvena

> Isvena is a leather goods house making hand-woven, vegetable-tanned (chrome-free) leather bags. The Signature Collection is fifteen pieces — totes and carryalls, shoulder and hobo bags, crossbody and belt bags, clutches and buckets, and small leather goods — each named in Italian and available in any of fourteen house colours. Every piece is made to order by artisans in the family workshop of P.M. Rahamathulla & Co. in Periyamet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, offered with free custom name engraving, and shipped worldwide. The family's leather heritage dates back to 1936.

## Key facts

- Brand: Isvena
- Parent / workshop: P.M. Rahamathulla & Co.
- Founded (leather heritage): 1936; direct-to-consumer brand launched 2016

- GST: 33ATYPS6349H1ZV

- Payment: Secure payment via Razorpay (cards, UPI, net banking, wallets)
- Production: Made to order; ships in 6–8 weeks
- Personalisation: Free custom name engraving on every piece, entered at checkout
- Colours: Every piece can be made in any of the fourteen house colours
- Signature technique: Hand-weaving — full-grain hide cut into strips (as fine as 4mm) and interlaced entirely by hand
- Collection: The Signature Collection, 2026 — 15 pieces, references ISV-001 to ISV-015
- Shipping cost: Complimentary worldwide on every order
- Materials: Vegetable-tanned, chrome-free full-grain leather (safe for skin, biodegradable, develops a patina)

## What "vegetable-tanned, chrome-free" means

Isvena leather is tanned with natural plant tannins instead of chromium salts. It contains no heavy metals, is safe to wear against the skin, is less likely to cause allergic reactions, is fully biodegradable, and develops a rich patina with age.

## Colour range

Nothing is held in stock, so every silhouette below can be woven in any of
these fourteen. The colour named beside a product is the one it was
photographed in, not a restriction.

Tan, Cognac, Caramel, Toffee, Chestnut, Mahogany, Oxblood, Dark Brown, Dark
Chocolate, Espresso, Nero, Forest Green, Antique Rose, Metallic Silver.

## Product categories

- Totes & Carryalls — Verona (tall shoulder tote, espresso), Siena (handheld basket tote, cognac), Rosa (wide-weave market tote, antique rose), Lucca (zigzag basket tote, toffee), Oliva (grand basket tote, forest green), Capri (shoulder basket tote, caramel)
- Shoulder & Hobo — Sofia (slouch hobo, tan), Luna (crescent shoulder bag, mahogany), Stella (flap shoulder bag, metallic silver)
- Crossbody & Belt — Piccola (mini basket crossbody, nero), Vita (woven belt bag, cognac)
- Clutches & Minis — Sera (wristlet clutch, dark chocolate), Gioia (drawstring bucket, chestnut)
- Small Leather Goods — Treccia (nine-strand hand-braided belt, dark brown), Milano (woven bifold wallet, oxblood)

## Weaves

- Diagonal intrecciato — fine hand-interlaced diagonal (Verona, Vita)
- Wide-strap intrecciato — supple, cushioned hand-feel (Siena, Sofia)
- Oversized checkerboard — 5 cm straps, hand-burnished (Rosa)
- Zigzag herringbone — tight, reads as fabric from a distance (Lucca, Oliva, Capri, Luna, Piccola, Sera)
- Fine herringbone — the tightest weave in the collection (Gioia)
- Micro-weave metallic intrecciato — shimmers like chainmail (Stella)
- Nine-strand flat hand braid — adjusts at any point, no punched holes (Treccia)

## Brand history

- 1936 — Founder P.M. Rahmathulla begins as an apprentice leather trader in British Colombo.
- 1944 — Starts his own tanning operation.
- 1950 — PMR & Co established.
- 1966 — Registers a trademark to export vegetable-tanned cow hides; success in the UK and Italy.
- 1990 — India bans export of vegetable-tanned leather, ending that chapter.
- 2000 — The family returns to the Chennai leather trade as wholesaler, exporter and importer.
- 2016 — P.M. Rahamathulla & Co. is founded in Periyamet, Chennai as a manufacturer of finished goods; Isvena becomes its direct-to-consumer brand.

## Custom name engraving

Every Isvena piece can be engraved with a name at no extra cost. The name is entered in a field at checkout (up to 20 characters) and is hand-embossed into the leather in the Chennai workshop while the piece is being made, not added afterwards. Engraving does not change the price or the 6–8 week lead time. Personalised pieces cannot be resold as stock, so they are not returnable.
